---

daughter of E. A.

Freeman, contributor to MP (1891-3)

Either she, or possibly her sister Margaret, took part in the Spider competitions under the name ‘Pisa’.

Unmarried in 1905, when she and her sister Helen were awarded a civil list pension in consideration of their father’s historical works. [The Times 22 June 1905]
